name: claude-md-claim-drift-guard
title: Correct the falsified CLAUDE.md behavior claims and guard them mechanically
description: A read-only audit on 2026-09-03 falsified seven claims in CLAUDE.md: the agent prompt asset section, the story channel count, the story artifact directory rule, three stale source citations, a broken experiment link, and an incomplete host hook and gate-required command inventory. The existing docs-drift preflight cannot catch any of them because it only checks command-name registration plus a path check that skips docs/story paths. Add a claim verifier that fails on the current document, then correct each falsified section until the verifier passes.
